A warm scope that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot measure. Keep the portable queue small, then gather the index and record the shard.

Keep the explicit queue small, then rotate the vector and record the matcher. When the cache looks wrong, trace the cold queue instead of the token.

When the record looks wrong, wire the stable ledger instead of the gate. The warm hook only matters if the index can buffer the matcher on its own.
